test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Mr. Hamel teaches the boys.

options.text: The boy’s are taught by Mr. Hamel.
The boys are being taught by Mr. Hamel.
The boys are taught by Mr. Hamel.
The boys were taught by Mr. Hamel.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The boys are taught by Mr. Hamel.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• **Active voice structure**: Subject + Verb + Objec
